razao: Tidybot is a complex domain involving robot movement, cart manipulation, and object placements. Planners using a portfolio of configurations with strong heuristics combining delete relaxation, causal graphs, and landmarks (such as LAMA) consistently achieve high coverage on this domain by balancing exploration and greedy search.
